title: 中医中五行传变推演
description:
五行传变推演
 基于《素问·玉机真藏论》五实五虚理论，分析[慢性肾病水肿]的五行传变路径，需结合《难经·十四难》脏腑虚实转化规律，生成动态病机演化图 
→ 关联《黄帝内经》与《难经》病机模型
remark: 分析中医中五行传变推演
notes:
. Five-Element Transmission Deduction
 
Based on the theory of "Five Excesses and Five Deficiencies" in Suwen · Yujizhencang Lun (Plain Questions · Treatise on the True Storage of Jade Mechanisms), analyze the five-element transmission pathway of [chronic kidney disease edema]. It is necessary to combine the law of viscera deficiency-excess transformation in Nanjing · Shisinan (Classic of Difficulties · Fourteen Difficulties) to generate a dynamic pathogenesis evolution diagram.
→ Associate the pathogenesis models of Huangdi Neijing (Yellow Emperor's Inner Canon) and Nanjing (Classic of Difficulties).
